ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 25% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity central region; high-intensity white patches are localized at the distal tips of both lobes and along the lower trailing edge bordering the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an approximate 45-degree internal angle at the central division of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with variable pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys; right lobe trailing edge exhibits deeper, more irregular indentations compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins display a pronounced convex sweep from the base towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast brown and white pixel rosettes (barnacles) localized on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, horizontally oriented white linear pixel disruptions are visible on the lower portion of the left lobe's dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the distal tips and a highly irregular, jagged trailing edge profile across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The white pigmentation on the right lobe distal tip forms a distinctive 'hook' shape near the trailing edge.
